channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Israeli forces kill Palestinian near Jenin in occupied West Bank
item.description: Israeli forces killed a Palestinian man near Jenin and an Israeli settler died from his wounds in a separate shooting.

item.title: What are Iran’s latest conditions to end its war with the US?
item.description: Iran's latest stipulations come as growing regional escalation causes oil prices to cross $100 per barrel.

item.title: Turkish FM says ready to meet Saudi defence needs – what does that mean?
item.description: Ankara expresses readiness to assist Riyadh as Houthi attacks escalate, testing a recent trilateral defence agreement.

item.title: ‘There will be a very sizeable Saudi response’ to Houthi attacks
item.description: Nawaf Obaid tells Al Jazeera that Saudi Arabia’s response to Houthi attacks from Yemen will be massive.

item.title: Two killed in Ukrainian drone attack on Moscow, says Russia
item.description: Moscow mayor says Russia has intercepted 1,600 drones since Saturday, including 450 directed at the capital.

item.title: Tunisian protesters demand release of four Sumud activists
item.description: The protest comes as the health of one detainee deteriorates after more than a month on hunger strike.

item.title: Morocco’s PJD: what has the party learned ahead of the 2026 election?
item.description: After its 2021 defeat, the party with an Islamic reference is rebuilding under Abdelilah Benkirane. Can it regain trust?

item.title: Ed Sheeran admits 'mistakes' at first show since Macklemore controversy
item.description: The singer spoke about Israel and Gaza after Macklemore was dropped from his tour for making pro-Palestinian remarks on stage.

item.title: Houthis say they targeted Saudi capital with ballistic missiles
item.description: A reported strike on a fuel depot at Riyadh airport caused delays on Saturday, as Saudi Arabia says it shot down a ballistic missile aimed at the capital.

item.title: Grim discoveries of murdered women spark fear in South Africa
item.description: Dineo Motapane is one of nine recent victims whose deaths have left a nation traumatised over the level of violence against women.
